title: Run project-declared nightly canonical checks and route regressions
description: Run a reviewed full suite against a pinned canonical commit during the project idle window, using the same scarce-resource queue and frozen input/condition proof as daytime checks. Attribute first bad change only when evidence supports it; file or deduplicate tasks with the responsible implementation owner. Idle-machine work still uses power/resources and any AI triage budget must be explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: Nightly evidence identifies exact tested commit and full required suite with honest skipped/unsupported gates
A failure creates one proposed routed regression without guessed culprit attribution
Heavy checks respect resource capacity; idle windows and pause policy; interruption does not count as pass
